Asset type: Japanese beginner programming article, a meaningful illustrated three-panel teaching diagram. Wide landscape approximately 3:2; white-warm background. This is a NEW illustration, not a restyle of a slide.

Row 1 and 2 filled, rows 3 and 4 empty, and this remains visibly unfinished through panel 3. Do NOT turn it into a completed checklist.

Panel 2: SAME desk and SAME unfinished checklist, now crowded with stacks of paper reaching a clearly marked desk edge and an orange stop hand/symbol; short large top label exactly "② 机がいっぱいで中断".
Panel 3: cleanup worker reaches toward THE SAME unfinished clipboard and uses it to sort a folder into a tray; show the hand or gaze tracing toward one EMPTY field, a small orange magnifying callout making that empty field visible. Short large top label exactly "③ 書きかけのまま使う". No checkmarks added to the empty fields, no approval badge.
